nova-scotia.territory: Mi'kma'ki, unceded territory of the Mi'kmaq
Mi'kma'ki, the territory of the Mi'kmaq

baselineHtml: Nova Scotia sits in Mi'kma'ki, unceded territory. Treaties of peace and friendship did not transfer title to the land at all.
